card.name: Verbs of giving after a drug or dose
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug name or dose in dosing and study sentences, such as "was", "administered", "Administer", or "mg". It also fires on the end of a brand name before "is administered".

modes.label: Verb after drug name
modes.description: A linking or giving verb such as "was" or "administered" directly follows a drug or dose phrase.

modes.label: Unit or brand ending
modes.description: The unit "mg" after a number, or the last piece of a brand name, just before "orally" or "is administered".
modes.example: . MYRBETRIQ Combination Therapy with Solifenacin Succinate The recommended starting dosage for combination treatment is MYRBETRIQ 25<< mg>> orally once daily and solifenacin succ
